plugin.tsimport.title: TorrServer Import
plugin.tsimport.import_hint: Adds to Silo every torrent from TorrServer that Silo does not have yet, with its title, poster and category.
plugin.tsimport.password_hint: Leave the password empty to keep the saved one. Login and password are those of TorrServer (its authentication), not of Silo.
plugin.tsimport.auto_hint: The automatic scan adds only torrents it has not seen before: a torrent deleted in Silo is not added back. It runs at Silo start and is woken every minute by Silo DSM.
plugin.tsimport.url_invalid: Enter the TorrServer address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8090
plugin.tsimport.interval_invalid: The interval must be from 1 to 1440 minutes
